title: Open Structures in Compactified Imaginary Liouville Theory
exact_target: Relate compactified imaginary Liouville theory to minimal models, formulate Felder's reduction by a path integral, characterize its logarithmic structure and construct the remaining coupling regimes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005928 (OWR-14298373-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Statistical Physics and Random Surfaces (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/25, pp. 1387--1444. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The catalogue condenses five primary-source questions to four and omits the $\beta\in[\sqrt2,2)$ construction question. Its first relationship is with BPZ minimal models, and its path-integral question concerns Felder's BRST reduction. The report already constructs CILT in a smaller rational-coupling regime. The recovered questions above correct these ambiguities; the recorded catalogue wording below is retained for traceability. No positivity of the complex formal path-integral weight is assumed.
